rules.rule: Use only relationships explicitly defined in relationships.json when generating JOINs.
Do not invent, infer, or assume relationships that are not explicitly defined in the schema or relationships.json.
For customer-level transaction queries, join customers to transactions through accounts.
For customer-level card queries, join customers to cards through accounts.
For customer-level loan queries, use the direct customers.customer_id to loans.customer_id relationship.
Do not join loans directly to accounts because no such relationship is defined.
Transaction Volume is calculated as SUM(transactions.amount_usd).
Total Balance is calculated as SUM(accounts.balance_usd).
Loan Exposure is calculated as SUM(loans.loan_amount).
Sample data must not be used to infer row counts, distributions, nullability, or business rules not explicitly defined in the schema.
